title: `dt.replace_time_zone('UTC')` and `dt.replace_time_zone(None)` keep the wall clock of a UTC instant
verdict: a naive Datetime becomes the UTC instant of the same microseconds, and back
description: `replace_time_zone('UTC')` of a naive `Datetime("us")` gives `Datetime("us", "UTC")` with the same epoch microseconds (including year 1 and NULL), and `replace_time_zone(None)` of that gives the naive timestamp back: both directions at UTC, which has no DST, so no gap or overlap arises.
reference: `UnFn.atUtc` (D53) returns its argument; Polars gives it natively.
